nom: Athletic Cosmetic Company Clear Power Sunscreen SPF 50 Invisible No White Cast Sweat & Water Resistant

avis.titre: The best sunscreen for any occasion!
avis.texte: I've been using Athletic Cosmetic's Clear Sunscreen, and it's quickly become a staple in my routine. It goes on completely clear, feels incredibly lightweight, and doesn't leave any white residue like most. I have very sensitive skin and it's hard for me to find an effective sunscreen so I'm so grateful for this find. What I love the most is also how convenient it is— I use it everyday whether it's as a pre makeup skincare or right before I play tennis outside. I highly recommend!
I love this sunscreen. It goes on invisibly and it's not greasy

Living in Florida, I need a sunscreen that feels light and stays comfortable. This one goes on smoothly, isn't greasy, and works great for busy days and gym sessions. It gives good protection without feeling heavy on my skin.
